subject: english
question:
In the following question, out of the given four alternatives, select the alternative which best expresses the meaning of the Idiom/Phrase.

The life and soul of the party

options.text: The only person who dances in the party
A person who brings lots of gifts
Person who brings lots of energy to the party

solution: The correct answer is **'Option 4'.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The idiom **'The life and soul of the party'** typically refers to a person who is energetic and entertaining and, at a social event, makes it enjoyable for everyone else. • (पार्टी की जान) • From the given options, 'Person who brings lots of energy to the party' is the accurate interpretation of the idiom.(व्यक्ति जो पार्टी में बहुत सारी ऊर्जा लाता है) Therefore, the **correct answer **is-** 'Person who brings lot of energy to the party'.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** • The only person who dances in the party: (पार्टी में नाचने वाला एकमात्र व्यक्ति) • Chief guest of the party:(पार्टी का मुख्य अतिथि) • A person who brings lots of gifts: (व्यक्ति जो बहुत सारे उपहार लेता है) 33:T939, The correct answer is** 'Option 3'.**
